summary: The audit checks the 45 units, GEOPHYS 201, 6 units of GEOPHYS 400, and one course from each of the four How We Study areas, with lecture courses letter graded unless S/NC is the only option. Checked by hand: the 1-2 What We Study courses chosen with your advisor (GEOPHYS 230 or 239 count there or under How We Study, not both), the advisor-approved courses that make up the rest of the 45 units, the research presentation and report, and the 3.0 GPA. The overview's "at least one course from any of the following 4 areas" could also mean one course in all; the audit asks for one per area.

TXKnwGzt.why: Overview. "Students must complete a minimum of 45 units of coursework" is the program's minimum and the block's floor; "Lecture courses (component LEC) must be taken for a letter grade unless S/NC is the only option offered" is set on the area course lists; the GPA is a separate rule. "Complete at least one course from any of the following 4 areas" is ambiguous (one course in all, or one per area); the data's one per area is kept.
